items.title: Texas Instruments (TXN) Remains A Preferred Pick Despite Chip Oversupply Risk
items.summary: UBS highlighted a fresh semiconductor oversupply risk on 24 November 2026, while keeping Texas Instruments (NasdaqGS:TXN) as a preferred stock. The bank pointed to rising chip inventories across manufacturers, indicating shipments may be running ahead of end-customer demand. UBS framed Texas Instruments as relatively well positioned within the sector despite the oversupply concern affecting the wider chip market.
